claim.claim-text: 1. A cam for cold working a pipe element, said cam comprising:
2. The cam according to claim 1, wherein said stop surface has a concave curvature.

3. The cam according to claim 1, further comprising at least one rib, said rib being positioned adjacent to a respective one of said cam surfaces and extending around a portion of said cam body, said rib having first and second oppositely disposed ends, said stop surface being positioned at one of said ends of said rib; preferably further comprising a plurality of said ribs, each said rib having at least one said stop surface at one end thereof, all of said ribs being circumferentially aligned with one another.

4. The cam according to claim 1, wherein each of said cam surfaces further comprises a region of constant radius positioned adjacent to a respective one of said discontinuities; preferably the cam further comprising:

- wherein all of said traction surfaces are circumferentially aligned with one another; and/or - wherein said traction surfaces overlie said cam surfaces; or - wherein said traction surfaces are positioned on said cam body in spaced relation to said cam surfaces;or - wherein the cam comprises at most two of said cam surfaces and two of said discontinuities of said cam surfaces;or - wherein the cam comprises at most two of said cam surfaces, two of said discontinuities of said cam surfaces, two of said traction surfaces two of said gaps in said traction surfaces and at most one of said stop surfaces;or - wherein the cam comprises at least two of said stop surfaces.
